components.title: Part A - business day date calc
components.what: Starting 2026-04-02, count 88 business days (Mon-Fri), skipping holidays 2026-04-24, 2026-04-27, 2026-05-15, 2026-07-07, 2026-07-24. Find the resulting date. Verify by listing week-by-week or using a date calculator logic, confirm holidays fall on weekdays within range and are excluded from the coun

components.title: Part B - modular exponentiation
components.what: Compute 60^423 mod 101. Use Fermat's little theorem (101 prime, so 60^100 ≡1 mod 101); reduce exponent 423 mod 100 = 23, compute 60^23 mod 101 via fast exponentiation. Show intermediate squarings for verification.

components.title: Part C - sequential account balance simulation
components.what: Starting balance $4300.00, apply 15 monthly transactions in given order, after each transaction check if balance <2000 then subtract $8 fee, then add 0.25% interest on resulting balance. Compute final balance after month 15 to the cent, showing running balance after each month for verification.

components.title: Part D - large multiplication and digit sum
components.what: Compute 79971 x 4700 x 720 x 8627 exactly, then sum the decimal digits of the result. Show the product computation stepwise (e.g., multiply pairs sequentially) so it can be independently recomputed/verified.
